title: Gradient Descent
subtitle: How AI reduces error one small step at a time

scene_timing.title: Gradient Descent
scene_timing.subtitle: How AI learns from a mistake
scene_timing.caption: First, the model gets an answer wrong.

scene_timing.title: Measure the loss
scene_timing.subtitle: The mistake becomes a score.
scene_timing.caption: Loss turns the mistake into a number AI can reduce.

scene_timing.title: Loss curve
scene_timing.subtitle: Every setting has a different loss.
scene_timing.caption: The curve is a map of better and worse settings.

scene_timing.title: Gradient direction
scene_timing.subtitle: The slope says which way loss rises.
scene_timing.caption: Gradient points uphill, so descent moves the other way.

scene_timing.title: Take one small update
scene_timing.subtitle: Move opposite the gradient.
scene_timing.caption: A small update changes the weight without jumping blindly.

scene_timing.title: Lower loss
scene_timing.subtitle: The new setting is less wrong.
scene_timing.caption: After the step, the loss score is lower.

scene_timing.title: Repeat small steps
scene_timing.subtitle: Training is the loop, not one magic jump.
scene_timing.caption: Repeat: measure loss, check slope, step downhill.

scene_timing.title: Step size check
scene_timing.subtitle: Too large a step can overshoot the low point.
scene_timing.caption: Good training uses repeated careful steps.
